behavioral_effects: Landing a change now requires proof that inherited validation ran, regeneration of generated files after every rebase (conflicted or not), and a pre-change rerun before attributing a red push; the shrink-pass precondition accepts gov-change's inline form
compatibility_impact: None - no interface, schema, or contract changes
limitations: Shrink pass ran in its inline form (documentation-only diff): nothing removed, because the file is a reviewed staged copy installed byte-for-byte so the review bookkeeping can match it; every added rule traces to an ACTIONED observation in the archived task-observer log
The 2026-08-30 and 2026-10-14 staged copies were compared: every line the older one added appears in the newer one, so no merge was needed
reason: The live ship skill had not changed since 2026-08-20, and pushes kept landing on unchecked assumptions: a conflict-free rebase left an already-committed Summary.md stale with no signal anywhere (observation 36), generated-file conflicts were hand-merged instead of regenerated (31), a zero check count or a green badge from another ref was read as passing (16), and its shrink-pass precondition still demanded simplify where gov-change now sanctions an inline pass for small diffs (84). Reviews on 2026-08-30 and 2026-10-14 staged the fixes; installing the 2026-10-14 copy, which contains the 2026-08-30 copy's changes, makes the landing step check them.
rollback: git revert restores the previous skill text. The staged source copy stays outside the repository at ~/.claude/skill-updates/2026-10-14/ship and is not touched by a revert
security_impact: None - agent-facing skill text only; no runtime code, configuration, or permission changes
summary: Install the reviewed ship update: proof that inherited validation ran, and regeneration after every rebase
